Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Umbra Vascular Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Umbra Vascular Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Umbra Vascular Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T and 3.0T
Type of Nuclei No additional nuclei
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 3,000 Gauss/cm
RF Transmit Coil Type Use the body transmit coil
RF Conditions Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes. A cooling period of 5 minutes is required between scans.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
